newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Anglo sets up unit for oil-related assets.
newsitem.headline: Anglo sets up unit for oil-related assets.

text.p: Anglo Philippine Holdings Corp said on Thursday its board had approved a resolution incorporating a wholly-owned subsidiary which will absorb its oil exploration-related assets.

Acting corporate secretary Ana Margarita Katigbak told the Philippine Stock Exchange that the new company, Filipinas Energy Corp, will have an authorised capital of 10 million pesos, of which 2.5 million pesos will be paid-up and subscribed.
"It is envisioned that the oil exploration-related assets of the company will be transferred to Fil-Energy in exchange for shares of stock," she said.
Anglo has interests in real estate and construction ventures including the mass transit railway system which will run along Manila's major EDSA thoroughfare.
